title: Rekha Garments executes an export order
body: Rekha Garments, a manufacturer in Tiruppur, has received an order from Swift Imports Ltd., Australia, for 2,000 men's trousers. Before accepting, the firm checked the creditworthiness of Swift Imports and asked it for a letter of credit from its bank. Rekha Garments already holds an Import Export Code number, is a member of the Apparel Export Promotion Council and is registered with the ECGC. It took pre-shipment finance from its bank, produced the trousers, got them packed and marked, insured them against the perils of the sea, and had its C&F agent complete customs clearance at the port. After the goods were loaded, the mate's receipt was obtained, freight was paid and the shipping company issued the bill of lading. The firm now has to secure payment. Its finance manager points out that Swift Imports will pay only when the documents reach Australia, but the firm needs money at once to buy fabric for its next order.
